programs.description: Kajal falls in love with Amit, an unemployed journalist. She urges him to focus on his career and provides unconditional support, but destiny has other plans for the couple.
The host plays devotional songs that praise the Almighty and imbues oneself with peace and tranquility and explores various places of worship.
Narsingh, a taxi driver, decides to return to his native place, but finds himself involved with a businessman en route, who is also a smuggler and human trafficker.

Kaushik is shattered when his mistress, Mita, dies in an accident. To add to his agony, he struggles to win back his wife's trust as he tries to improve their relationship.
When his sister Sandhya is raped and murdered by Ratan, Shankar decides to seek revenge. In his mission, he receives the support of his long-lost childhood friend, Rajib, who is now a police officer.
